# laravel_cloud_environment_secret (Resource)

Attaches an organization secret (laravel_cloud_secret) to an environment. Destroying this detaches the secret; the secret itself is kept.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravel_cloud_secret" "stripe" {
  key   = "STRIPE_SECRET"
  value = var.stripe_secret
}

resource "laravel_cloud_environment_secret" "stripe" {
  environment_id = laravel_cloud_environment.example.id
  secret_id      = laravel_cloud_secret.stripe.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID.
- `secret_id` (String) Secret ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) "<environment_id>/<secret_id>".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravel_cloud_environment_secret.stripe "{environment_id}/{secret_id}"
```
